metadata.scope_note: This file includes GPU-bearing EC2 instance types from AWS EC2 instance specification pages. It separately flags which instance families are covered by the user-linked DLAMI recommendation page.
important_notes: G6f and Gr6f rows are fractional/shared GPU profiles. AWS shows 0 full attached GPUs in the instance table for those sizes.
The DLAMI page the user linked is not an exhaustive list of every GPU-bearing EC2 family in the EC2 instance type docs.
P4 includes p4d and p4de variants; P3 coverage here includes p3dn as a closely related V100-based variant.
AWS expresses memory in GiB in the source tables.
